seedQuestions.text: How do you make a new place feel like home?
seedQuestions.detail: I’m new on campus and would love to hear what helped you settle in.

responses.text: Finding a regular little routine helped me. Try a weekly library visit or the same coffee spot.
Join one small group around something you already enjoy. Having familiar faces makes such a difference.

seedQuestions.text: Where’s your favorite quiet spot to study?
seedQuestions.detail: Bonus points for natural light and somewhere to grab a coffee nearby.

responses.text: The second floor of the library, by the big windows!

seedQuestions.text: What’s a hobby you’d love to try, but haven’t yet?
seedQuestions.detail: Mine is pottery. I think making something with my hands would be so calming.

responses.text: Film photography. I love the idea of slowing down to notice things.

seedQuestions.text: Anyone want to work through our first coding project together?
seedQuestions.detail: I’m learning JavaScript and could use a study buddy.

responses.text: Count me in! I’m working through the basics too.

seedQuestions.text: Is a perfect weekend planned or spontaneous?
seedQuestions.detail: I’m curious how everyone likes to recharge.

responses.text: One small plan and lots of room for surprises.

answers.text: A little fresh air and a morning walk. Even ten minutes makes a difference.
Finding a new song that I want to play on repeat.
When someone remembers a small thing I told them.
